lines.text: What tells your forehead to frown?
lines.phonemes: wˌɒt tˈɛlz jɔː fˈɔːhɛd tə fɹˈaʊn?

lines.text: It starts at the end of a nerve.
lines.phonemes: ɪt stˈɑːts at ðɪ ˈɛnd əvə nˈɜːv.

lines.text: The nerve lets out a chemical messenger called acetylcholine.
lines.phonemes: ðə nˈɜːv lˈɛts ˈaʊt ɐ kˈɛmɪkəl mˈɛsɪndʒə kˈɔːld ˈasɪtˌɪlkəlˌiːn.

lines.text: The muscle fibre gets the message, and pulls.
lines.phonemes: ðə mˈʌsəl fˈaɪbə ɡˈɛts ðə mˈɛsɪdʒ, and pˈʊlz.

lines.text: Botulinum toxin gets inside the nerve ending.
lines.phonemes: bˌɒtjʊlˈaɪnəm tˈɒksɪn ɡˈɛts ɪnsˈaɪd ðə nˈɜːv ˈɛndɪŋ.

lines.text: It blocks proteins the nerve needs to send the message.
lines.phonemes: ɪt blˈɒks pɹˈəʊtiːnz ðə nˈɜːv nˈiːdz tə sˈɛnd ðə mˈɛsɪdʒ.

lines.text: So, for a while, the message is not sent.
lines.phonemes: sˈəʊ, fəɹə wˈaɪl, ðə mˈɛsɪdʒ ɪz nˌɒt sˈɛnt.

lines.text: The skin was never the target. The message was.
lines.phonemes: ðə skˈɪn wɒz nˈɛvə ðə tˈɑːɡɪt. ðə mˈɛsɪdʒ wɒz.
